errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are ordered by size in descending order, but this is not true. Following the largest sector (26.7%), the next one in counter-clockwise order is 20.0%, which is smaller than the following one (22.2%). The visual arrangement of the slices does not follow a size-based order.

errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. It is unclear which are the "last three sectors", but in any interpretation, they are not approximately equal. The three smallest sectors are 13.3%, 8.9%, and 8.9%, where 13.3% is not approximately equal to 8.9%. Other groupings of three sectors also show significant differences in size.
